# Deterministic visual fixture rasters

The 12 JPEG files are test-only thumbnail crops from the six-screen design images approved on 6 November 2026. Originals: `docs/design/2026-11-06-simplified/04-videos.png` and `05-photos.png`, generated by OpenAI Image Gen for this project. Each crop is resized to 640 × 360 and JPEG encoded at quality 85. The original design PNGs are unchanged.

These illustrative images are served only by Vite's DEV middleware at `/__fixtures/redesign/`. They are never copied to `public/` or included in release bundles. They are not represented as frames from a user's media.
